  4) Reboot the device.
  5) Connect with SSH to device.
  6) Verify warning message is displayed.
  7) Delete key in client store.(known_hosts)
  8) Connect with SSH to device.

1520301.steps:
1) In CLI go to config > ssh server and issue command: ssh port 54022
  2) Initiate SSH to device on port 22: ssh ip_address
  3) Verify cannot connect
  4) Initiate SSH to device on new port : ssh ip_address -p 54022
  5) Verify can connect
  6) Reset port to default using CLI
  7) Initiate SSH to device: ssh ip_address -p 54022
  8) Verify cannot connect
  9) Initiate SSH to device: ssh ip_address
  10) Verify can connect

Device setup with SSH enabled.
